music.note: Beat n of the track is at firstBeat + n*beat (attack times: the onset-fitted grid plus 18 ms, measured on beat-averaged transients); downbeats are n = 3 mod 4. Film 0-1.92 s is Sprite Fright's own sound at its own 160 BPM, handing over on its beat; film beats 4-15 are track beats 283-294 (a drum section of the climax), entering on the hit at beat 283; film beat k >= 16 is track beat 171+k up to the closing splice.

segments.note: cold open on Red's drums: track beats 283-294, entering 5 ms before the hit at beat 283; the shots cut on its measured hits (beats 283, 286, 287, 289, 290, 291)
track beats 187-271: build under the hook, break at 94.5 s, drop at 97.93 s (film 15.36, giveUp), climax at 126.73 s (film 44.16, brand)
the closing F minor chord, after the C-major bar: a cadence on film beat 100

tails.note: the downbeat after the cold open rings out over the cut to the hook

original.note: Sprite Fright's own soundtrack under the opening (160 BPM, a beat every 0.375 s): the scream 'Aaaah! My eyes!'. It starts so that its accent at 331.877 s falls on film 1.92 s, where Red's hit takes over; the recorded kit (audio/opening.json) plays along on its beats.
